name: NTPC Ltd
description: NTPC Ltd is India's largest power utility, contributing approximately 25% of India's total electricity generation with over 76 GW of installed thermal, hydro, solar, and wind capacity. Functioning under the Ministry of Power, NTPC is aggressively executing India's energy transition via subsidiary NTPC Green Energy Ltd (NGEL), targeting 60 GW of renewable capacity by 2032.

company_profile.summary: NTPC Ltd is India's largest power utility, contributing approximately 25% of India's total electricity generation with over 76 GW of installed thermal, hydro, solar, and wind capacity. Functioning under the Ministry of Power, NTPC is aggressively executing India's energy transition via subsidiary NTPC Green Energy Ltd (NGEL), targeting 60 GW of renewable capacity by 2032.

revenue_breakup.desc: Coal and gas-fired base load electricity sold to state discoms under long-term PPAs.
Utility-scale solar parks, floating solar plants, and wind power generation.
Cross-border power trading, project engineering consultancy, and captive coal mining.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (India): 100% across nationwide inter-state transmission grids
moats_and_strengths: Sovereign Maharatna status with guaranteed 15.5% regulated Return on Equity (RoE) under CERC tariff frameworks.
100% of generation capacity tied up under multi-decade Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with tripartite payment security.
Captive coal blocks meeting over 15% of fuel requirements, insulating plants from international coal price spikes.
Lowest cost thermal power producer in India with plant load factor (PLF) consistently superior to national average.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Commercial Capacity: 76,000+ MW • Under Construction: 24,000+ MW (including 11 GW renewables)

bullish_triggers: Public listing of NTPC Green Energy Ltd (NGEL) unlocking value for parent shareholders.
Surge in peak domestic power demand reaching record highs above 250 GW driving thermal plant load factors.
Development of large-scale green hydrogen and nuclear power joint ventures with NPCIL.
bearish_risks: Payment delays or financial distress among state electricity distribution companies (Discoms).
Environmental compliance capex requirements for flue gas desulfurization (FGD) equipment.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)

peers.name: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd
